Class InstantMilliseconds

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.IInteger
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.InstantMilliseconds
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ObservableAttribute
public class InstantMilliseconds extends IInteger
SysMLinJava value type for time at an instant in milliseconds from the standard "epoch" time. This value type is a analog for the Java Instant.
Author:
ModelerOne

      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{

}
